title: Home
intro: A player’s guide to the current Tama game.

title: Attention & good care
intro: The Care page tells you what your Tama needs. Clear the need to clear its alert.

title: Buttons & first steps
intro: Four buttons are all you need to care for your Tama.

title: Corner Shop
intro: Littlebug Town’s little shop. Four things on the shelf, a friendly clerk, and new stock three times a day.

title: Growing up
intro: From one egg to an elder, through the forms your care leads to.

title: Fishing
intro: Cast a line at Littlebug Town’s Pond. Hook a fish, reel it in and keep it. Now and then you might pull up a boot.

title: Meals & snacks
intro: Meals fill the hunger bar. Snacks lift happiness. Both add a little weight.

title: Items
intro: Things your Tama owns, and how to look through them. Food lives on the Meals & snacks page.

title: Library
intro: The shelves are in place. Their contents are still to come.

title: Littlebug Town
intro: A little town with room to grow. The Pond is open for fishing; the other destinations can’t be entered yet.

title: Mail
intro: Your Tama’s letterbox. The inbox is in place; letters are still to come.

title: Sickness & medicine
intro: Fix the care problem first, then help your Tama recover.

title: The menu map
intro: Ten icons surround the screen. The triangle on the right points to the selected list entry.

title: Points
intro: Win points by playing games, then spend them at the Corner Shop.

title: Settings
intro: Press A and D together to open Settings from the home screen or any menu.

title: Sleep & Lights Out
intro: Rest restores energy. Lights Out lets you put your Tama to bed or wake it up.

title: Stats & hearts
intro: Count the hearts and check in before a small need becomes a care mistake.

title: World
intro: Places your Tama can visit. Choose World from the menu to see them. The Corner Shop and the Pond are open; the other places are still to come.

intro: A adult form in the Tama family.

intro: A baby form in the Tama family.

title: Meet the characters
intro: 13 characters, from a tiny egg to an elder. Explore each form’s traits and animations.

title: Jumping Rope
intro: Time your jumps so the rope passes beneath your character. The pace changes as your score increases.

title: Climb
intro: Your Tamagotchi stands on a cloud while another drifts back and forth above it. Jump at the right moment to land on it and climb: up through the night into space, down into an alien planet's air, and up to a sky serpent at the top.

title: Shape
intro: Shapes fall down two lanes. Change your shape with B until it matches, then throw it up the left or right lane to knock the falling shape out.

title: Flag
intro: Match the large flag cues by colour. Raise both flags for a double cue, and ignore small fake cues. Reversed positions do not change the colour controls.

title: Manhole
intro: Hearts, money bags and snakes fall towards four manholes, one for each button. Open a hole just as a treat arrives to catch it, but keep it shut when a snake is coming.

title: Memory
intro: Watch the pattern of arrows that appears above your Tamagotchi, then repeat it with the buttons. Each round the pattern is one arrow longer.

title: Blackjack
intro: Play blackjack for your points against Bill the dealer. Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over.

title: Match
intro: Take turns with another Tamagotchi flipping cards two at a time to find pairs. Find a pair and you go again.

title: Snap
intro: Cards turn over one by one onto a pile at the table. When the top two match, slap the pile before the other Tamagotchi does and it's yours.

title: Cup Game
intro: Watch the ball go under a cup, follow the cups as they are shuffled on the table, then lift the right one. Ten rounds, each harder than the last; from the seventh, more cups.

title: Crazy 8S
intro: Take turns with another Tamagotchi laying cards that match the pile by number or suit. Eights are wild, and black power cards go on anything: draw two, skip, swap hands and more. Be first to empty your hand.

title: Dots & Boxes
intro: Take turns with another Tamagotchi drawing lines between dots. Close a box to keep it and draw again; more boxes wins.

title: Mastermind
intro: Crack a hidden code of four marbles in eight guesses. Little key pegs tell you how close each guess was.

title: Gin Rummy
intro: One hand of Gin Rummy against another Tamagotchi. Take a card, throw one away, and meld your hand into runs and sets; knock when your deadwood is low.

title: Connect 4
intro: Take turns with another Tamagotchi dropping discs into an upright board. Four of yours in a row wins.

title: Pig
intro: Push your luck with a die against another Tamagotchi. Every roll adds to your turn's total, but the skull loses it all. Bank in time and be first to 50.

title: War
intro: Four Tamagotchis share a map. Place your armies, then attack your neighbours with a die for every army. Take every region to win.

title: Word Shake
intro: Shake 16 letter dice, then find as many words as you can before the clock runs out. Words your opponent also found don't count.

title: Spit
intro: A race with one deck: play a card one up or one down onto either pile before the other player does. First to get rid of every card wins.

title: Rock Star
intro: Notes roll down a four-lane highway: press A, B, C or D as each one reaches its target. Keep the streak going and the crowd happy.

title: Scrabble
intro: A short game of Scrabble against another Tamagotchi: take turns making words on the board from your 7 tiles. The higher total wins.

title: Dominion
intro: Build a deck against another Tamagotchi: play actions, buy treasure and better cards, and end with the most victory points. 10 of the 26 base-set kingdom cards each game.

title: The games room
intro: Learn the controls, see the screens, and find your next challenge.
